statement: Episode 1 of the combat guide series covers basic and advanced damage sources and focuses on weapon power and base damage and damage percent
Weapon power gives the biggest bang for your buck for damage scaling especially early game
Weapon power is a juiced down version of base damage; scale weapon power and base damage as high as possible before damage percent
Early game base stat is always superior to percent stat until mid to late game
Early game sharpened axe (base stat) is better than gilded sword (percent damage talent)
Three main beginner damage talents available to every class: sharpened axe for weapon power and gilded sword for damage percent and main stat
Overclocked energy and meat shank scale off MP and HP and are better for some classes; covered in another video
Pick the dungeonic damage star talent from the party dungeon shop; gives damage percent based on credits obtained
Family bonus from highest level beginner-line class (journeyman or maestro) gives weapon power based on level; great base stat source
First job advancement family bonuses: weapon power from barbarian and total damage percent from blood berserker
Dungeon flurbo shop is a great early weapon power source accessible as early as the frog map in world one
Do your happy hour every week to easily get up to 19.2 weapon power
A decently high guild has the power of pow perk giving up to plus 5 weapon power at level 50
Arcade golden ball shop rotation sells weapon power and base damage so save golden balls if you want more dps
Bribes and stamps scale a fair amount of damage and he invests into them very late game
Sword and long sword and scimitar stamps give base damage
Tomahawk and battle axe and pole arm stamps give damage percent; hunt stamps and also maximize early gains
Hunt down the photoshop damage range bribe which gives 2 percent total damage
Post office is a huge damage source; two damage boxes are civil war box and death storage
Civil war box in post office gives base damage
Death storage box gives weapon power and total damage percent and a little attack speed; get both boxes up asap
Power statue gives base damage and is an easy source
Buy a golden hammer in world 2 shop and drop it at a statue to make it gold; golden statues become account bound once upgraded at world 3
Damage shrine gives damage percent and scales its levels over time
Chaotic cheese card increases the shrine's effect percent
Star signs are an easy source of free damage
Good damage star signs: batty doo for damage percent and ned kelly for weapon power
Bullwork gives massive damage percent and the feisty star sign gives total damage percent
Fatty doo is the one star sign he says is not a good choice
For most of the game cards are the biggest source of damage and afk gains and efficiency
Weapon power cards that mattered: pincherman and detodated ram and chalky and radiant amarok
Damage percent cards: snowman and blood bone and dr defecas and the impossible blitz troll
Bosses and nightmares card set gives damage percent and drop and brain xp; use it for most mob farming
Farm cheese armor: the helmet and body plate give total damage percent and a little mastery; late game
The bigger the upgrade stone the more damage you get
Always upgrade your weapons first no matter what
Farm tenacity rings for total damage percent
Emperor opal rings are an option for big juicers but he does not suggest them
Neck pieces: chaotic cheese scarf gives damage percent and mob respawn; kamrock pendant and bludgeon give weapon power
Trophies: megalodon trophy for weapon power and crit chance; frosty prince for damage percent
Use king of food trophy if you are running damage spots but that is up to you
Strength pots are a great inexpensive source of base damage; fill up if you have a free spot
Golden food gives base damage from golden knowledge and damage percent from golden kebabs
Doing the picnic stowaway quest up to the magic meatloaf gives up to 32 golden kebabs a day
Aim for roughly 200 golden kebabs on each character; more golden food means diminishing returns
Premium wings: easter event wings and cheese wings both give damage percent; huge if you can get them but not a big deal
Premium hats are mostly mainstat not damage but some such as red boat hat have weapon power
Complete world 1 2 and 3 bosses for 30 percent damage and another 5 percent from the new fourth frog in world one
Orbs are a huge pain and pretty late game but give big damage
Big boy damage orb gives 1 weapon power at gold and 2 weapon power at plant
Farm chizoar for his hexagon orb which gives 4 weapon power and 4 percent total damage
Only two damage bubbles per cauldron; multiplier bubbles are class specific and not covered
Bubble number 5 of orange and green and purple cauldrons give base damage based on max HP and max speed and max MP respectively
The 9th bubble in each of those cauldrons gives damage percent; get these asap
Vials tail time (rats) and kraken aid (krakens) both give weapon power
Salt lick second page bottom upgrade gives total damage percent up to level 250 which is 25 percent but costs a lot of pinkies
Tier 1 wartooth keychain gives base damage
Tier 2 cactus keychain gives total damage percent
Tier 3 star blobby light keychain gives more total damage percent and weapon power
Cooking meals turkey a la thank and octoplop onion and massive fig all give a lot of damage percent
Pet arena is a huge damage source as a multiplier: round 8 gives 1.2x total damage and round 200 gives 1.4x for 1.6x total
Lab node jules animal farm gives damage percent based on how many species you have bred
Sigils of old alchemy give base damage and weapon power if unlocked in the alchemy section

subsystem: certified stamp book and chemistry set
statement: Certified stamp book doubles stamps and my first chemistry set doubles vials
Unadulterated banking fury gives damage percent based on 10 million stacks
Purple navette jewel gives more damage percent for animal farm
Pyramid jewel gives 1.5x damage but four gems all activated at once give 1.3x
Black diamond rhinestone increases the total damage percent of unadulterated banking fury

subsystem: max HP MP and movement speed
statement: Max HP and MP and movement speed boost damage a lot late game and apply account-wide so give all characters lots of each
Galvanic software chip gives a flat plus 10 total damage
Poker chip gives a 1.25x weapon power multiplier on weapons
Omega nano chip doubles the bonus of the card equipped in the top left slot
Omega motherboard doubles the card bonus of the bottom right slot
Silk road processor doubles the miscellaneous bonus of the currently equipped pendant
Silk road software doubles the miscellaneous bonus of the keychain in the upper keychain slot
Silk road motherboard doubles the trophy's miscellaneous bonus so frost prince gives 16 instead of 8 percent
Silk road nano chip doubles the bonuses of all active star signs
All these chips are huge priority and you should get them when they are in rotation
Further episodes are coming and class guides including maestro are coming soon
